## `neuro.object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors`

Static method on `Object`.

> Returns an object containing all own property descriptors of an object

## Signatures

```ts
getOwnPropertyDescriptors(input: { o: T; prompt?: string }): Promise<{ [P in keyof T]: TypedPropertyDescriptor<T[P]>; } & { [x: string]: PropertyDescriptor; }>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
